alt: Two cartoon children with different brown skin tones watch a colorful egg shaker held by the child with curly hair.
A hand holds an unmarked blue ruler on a table; faint outlines beside its overhanging end suggest back-and-forth movement.
A cartoon wooden frame drum with a cream drumhead sits beside a soft-headed mallet.
Six parallel strings cross the sound hole of a cartoon acoustic guitar, running from its bridge toward its neck.
Brown hands meet in front of a green shirt, with short action strokes suggesting a clap.
A cartoon child with pale skin and auburn hair touches a blank sheet of paper with one fingertip at a table.
A cartoon child with dark brown skin and short curly hair is shown in profile with one ear clearly visible.
Two cartoon children investigate an unmarked ruler over a table edge while an adult watches; one holds it and the other presses its free end.
Two cartoon views show brown hands tapping a frame drum and a light hand plucking one of six guitar strings.
A cartoon child with tan skin, black bobbed hair and a purple shirt rests two fingertips gently at the front of their throat.
Two cartoon views show a brown hand tapping a frame drum with a mallet, then an open hand resting on its head with the mallet set aside.
A dark brown cartoon hand holds a soft mallet against the cream head of a wooden frame drum.
A light brown cartoon hand touches a string over the sound hole of an acoustic guitar.
A cartoon child with dark brown skin, braids and an orange shirt rests two fingertips against their throat with lips closed.
A light-skinned cartoon child rests an open hand on a frame drumhead, with the mallet set aside on the table.
A dark brown cartoon hand rests across six guitar strings above the sound hole.
A cartoon child with brown skin, braids and an orange shirt sits cross-legged with hands in their lap and lips parted.
Two cartoon views show a brown-skinned child with curls and glasses touching their throat, then resting both hands in their lap.
A tan-skinned cartoon child with a black bob taps a red bar on a small multicolored barred instrument with a mallet.
A dark brown-skinned cartoon child with curly hair sits cross-legged and plucks a four-string ukulele.
A cartoon child with tan skin and wavy brown hair holds a brass handbell away from their face; its clapper is visible.
A light-skinned cartoon child using a wheelchair holds a drum mallet while a dark brown-skinned child touches the drum rim beside them.
A tan-skinned cartoon child holds a mallet at a frame drum and rests their other hand on its top; blank paper and a pencil lie nearby.
A cartoon teacher and two children watch a paper strip hanging from a stand beside a compact speaker.
Four cartoon scenes show rain on a window, a bird with an open beak, hands opening a backpack zipper, and a hand holding an egg shaker.
